description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to Security Features and Security Features Management System (Excise Notification No. 10/2021
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of rules under the Excise Ordinance, specifically modifying notification timelines for security features management. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and legal modifications, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions Basil Rajapaksa as Minister of Finance, this is incidental to the regulatory action being taken, and there is no detailed description of portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes that would trigger a government-related classification.
